generation_info.framework: Dynamic Digital Twin Framework for Multi-Objective Building Retrofit Optimization

weather_climate.description: Weather and climate data for building energy simulation

economic_market.description: Economic and market data for retrofit cost-benefit analysis

geospatial_regulatory.spatial_coverage: 5 major US cities, key grid regions

key_features: Hourly weather data with realistic seasonal/diurnal patterns
Climate change projections for future-proofing strategies
Time-of-use energy pricing with peak/off-peak rates
Comprehensive material and technology cost database
Regional labor costs by trade and skill level
Real-time grid carbon intensity for emissions optimization
Building code requirements by climate zone
Local emissions standards (NYC Local Law 97, Boston BERDO)

integration_features.unified_access: Single API for all data categories

next_steps: Integrate with IoT sensors for real-time data
Implement machine learning for pattern recognition
Add more geographic regions and climate zones
Integrate with BIM and digital twin platforms
